title: SmolWAM: A Latent World-Action Model for Robotic Manipulation on Edge Devices
abstract: arXiv:2610.13740v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: World-action models (WAMs) predict a robot's actions together with the observations those actions will produce. However, the strongest models rely on video diffusion transformers that are far too computationally expensive for resource-constrained edge devices. We present SmolWAM, a latent WAM that we derive from the 2B-parameter Cosmos Policy by keeping its pretrained trunk and rebuilding its inference interface: single-frame visual latents, cached text features that preserve the trunk's attention sinks, 12 of 28 transformer blocks, and 1,008 tokens from which actions and future visual latents are read out in one rectified-flow step. Trained in 3.6 GPU-hours, SmolWAM succeeds in 95.5% of 400 LIBERO episodes at 57 ms and 2.3 TFLOP per 16-action chunk with 2.4 GiB of GPU memory, 11x faster than its teacher with 18.5x fewer FLOPs and 3.2x less memory, and its world head still forecasts scene motion.

translated_title: SmolWAM：面向边缘设备机器人操作的潜在世界-动作模型
translated_abstract: 世界-动作模型（WAM）能够同时预测机器人的动作以及这些动作将产生的观测结果。然而，目前最强的模型依赖于视频扩散Transformer，其计算开销对于资源受限的边缘设备而言过于昂贵。我们提出了SmolWAM，这是一种由20亿参数的Cosmos Policy衍生而来的潜在世界-动作模型：我们保留了其预训练主干，并重建了其推理接口，包括单帧视觉潜变量、保留主干注意力汇的缓存文本特征、28个Transformer块中的12个，以及1,008个token——动作和未来视觉潜变量可在一次整流流步骤中从中读出。仅需3.6 GPU小时的训练，SmolWAM便在400个LIBERO任务中取得95.5%的成功率，每个16动作块仅需57毫秒和2.3 TFLOP的计算量，GPU显存占用仅2.4 GiB，比其教师模型快11倍、FLOP减少18.5倍、显存减少3.2倍，且其世界模型头仍然能够预测场景的运动。
tldr: SmolWAM通过复用20亿参数教师模型的预训练主干并精简推理接口，仅用3.6 GPU小时训练出一个轻量潜在世界-动作模型，在边缘设备上以快11倍的速度实现95.5%的操作成功率，同时仍保留预测场景运动的能力。
en_tdlr: SmolWAM is a lightweight latent world-action model derived from the 2B-parameter Cosmos Policy by reusing its pretrained trunk and streamlining the inference interface, training in just 3.6 GPU-hours, achieving 95.5% success on LIBERO while running 11x faster than its teacher on edge devices, and still forecasting scene motion.
